description: S458 2a-fix F1: `bind:value` on a REFINED struct field is judged by that field's own refinement, against the value that is written. `@p.n` is `number(>0)`: typing "-5" is refused and @p keeps n = 1; typing "7" into `@q.n` writes the NUMBER 7 (a numeric refinement renders `type="number"`, so the written value is the number, and the judge checks the base type).
rationale: §53.7.2: "If the check fails, the assignment is not applied and the reactive variable retains its prior value." §53.7.1: a numeric refinement bound with bind:value renders a number input.
